questions.question: If 2a + 3b = 8 and ab = 5, then find the value of 4a² + 9b².
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2a + 3b = 8 

ab = 5

**Formula used:**

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

**Calculations:**

Squaring the given equation,

⇒ (2a + 3b)² = 64

⇒ 4a² + 9b² + 12ab = 64

Substituting the value of ab,

⇒ 4a² + 9b² + (12 × 5) = 64

⇒ 4a2 + 9b2 = 64 – 60 = 4

**∴ The value of 4a2 + 9b2 is 4**

questions.question: Rakesh walking at the speed of 8 km/h crosses a bridge in 30 minutes. What is the length of the bridge in kilometre?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Rakesh = 8 km/h

Time taken by Rakesh to cross the bridge = 30 minutes = (1/2) hours

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculations:**

Let the length of the bridge be l

⇒ 8 = l/(1/2)

⇒ l = 8 × (1/2)

⇒ l = 4 km

**∴ The length of the bridge is 4 km**

questions.question: In how many years will a sum of ₹ 5000 yield a simple interest of ₹ 2000 at an interest rate of 10 p.a.?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 5000

Simple interest = Rs. 2000

Rate of interest = 10%

**Formula used:**

SI = frac{{P × {{R}} × {{T}}}}{{100}}

**Calculations:**

Let the sum be invested for T years

⇒ 2000 = (5000 × 10 × T)/100

⇒ 2000 = 500T

⇒ T = 20/5

⇒ T = 4 years

**∴ The sum of Rs. 5000 earns a simple interest of Rs. 2000 in 4 years**

questions.question: In ΔXYZ, if G is the centroid and XL is the median with a length 18 cm, then the length XG is:
questions.solution:
**Given :**

XL is the centroid of a triangle XYZ and G is the centroid of the median 

**Concept used :**

In a triangle ABC if a median AD is drawn from A to side C, then centroid G divides the AD in the ratio 2 : 1

**Calculations :**

XL = XG + GL

XG: GL = 2: 1 (G is the centroid)

⇒ XG = (2/3) of XL 

⇒ XG = (2/3) × 18

⇒ XG = 12 

∴ **XG is 12 cm.**

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 3?
questions.solution:
**Concept used :**

If the sum of digits of a number is divisible by 3, then the number is also divisible by 3

**Calculations :**

Sum of digits 

1st option = 8 + 7 + 0 + 3 + 5 + 4 + 1 = 28

2nd option = 8 + 7 + 0 + 3 + 5 + 9 + 3 = 35

3rd option = 8 + 7 + 0 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 2 = 32

4th option = 8 + 7 + 6 + 5 + 0 + 0 + 1 = 27 

We can check that only 27 is the multiple of 3 

∴ **Option 4 is the only option divisible by 3 **

questions.question: tan²x – 3 sec²x + 3 = 0, then the value of x (0 ≤ x ≤ 90°) is:
questions.solution:

**Formula used :**

sec²x = 1 + tan²x 

**Calculations :**

tan²x - 3 sec²x + 3 = 0 

put sec²x = 1 + tan²x 

⇒ tan²x - 3 (1 + tan²x) + 3 = 0

⇒ tan²x - 3 - 3 tan²x + 3 = 0 

⇒ -2 tan²x = 0 

⇒ tan²x = 0 

⇒ tan x = 0 (tan x = 0, when x = 0°)

∴ **x will be 0°**

questions.question: A man sold his furniture at a 25% gain. Had he sold at 15% loss. He would have received ₹ 800 less. Find cost price of the furniture.
questions.solution:
**Given :**

A man sold his furniture at 25% gain.

Had he sold at 15% loss he would have received Rs.800 less 

**Concept used :**

Profit = selling price - cost price = profit % on cost price 

Loss = cost price - selling price = loss % on cost price 

**Calculations :**

Let the cost price of the item be 100x 

Selling price at 25% profit = cost price + profit 

⇒ cost price + 25% of 100x 

⇒ 100x + 25x = 125x 

Selling price at 15% loss = cost price - loss

⇒ 100x - 15% of 100x 

According to the question 

125x - 85x = 800 

⇒ 40x = 800 

⇒ x = 20 

⇒ cost price = 100x 

⇒ 100 × 20 = 2000 rupees 

∴ **Cost price of the furniture is 2000 rupees **

questions.question: Given that the mean of five numbers is 28. If one of them is excluded, the mean gets reduced by 5. Determine the excluded number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The mean of 5 numbers is 28

One number is excluded so mean decreased by 5 i.e. 23

**Formula Used:**

Sum of numbers = Mean × No. of numbers

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of the 5 numbers = 5 × 28 = 140

Mean of 4 numbers is 23

⇒ Sum of the remaining four numbers = 4 × 23 = 92

∴ Excluded number = 140 – 92 = 48

questions.question: If x + y = 15 and xy = 14, then the value of x – y is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y = 15, xy = 14

**Formula Used:**

(x – y)² = (x + y)² – 4xy

**Calculation:**

⇒ (x – y)² = (15)² – 4 × 14 = 225 – 56 = 169

∴ x – y = 13

questions.question: A blanket is sold for Rs 680 at the discount of 15% and 20%. Find the printed price of the blanket.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of blanket = Rs 680

Discount = 15% and 20%

**Formula Used:**

Printed price = Selling price × [100/(100 – discount%)]

**Calculation:**

Printed price = Selling price × [100/(100 – discount%)]

⇒ 680 × [100/(100 – 15)] × [100/(100 – 20)]

⇒ 680 × (100/85) × (100/80)

⇒ 1000

**∴**** The printed price of the blanket is Rs 1000**
